items.title: Fleet Logistics Modernization
items.challenge: Fragmented fleet tracking caused coordination delays of several hours every single day.
items.summary: We unified scattered fleet-tracking data into a single coordination platform so operations can plan routes and schedules from live conditions.
items.challengeDetail: The fleet was tracked through three disconnected systems. Dispatchers copied data by hand and only learned about delays after customers complained, so delivery coordination slipped by several hours every day.

solution.title: Mapping the operation
solution.description: We shadowed dispatchers for two weeks and mapped where information broke down.

solution.title: One tracking platform
solution.description: Data from all three systems was merged into a single live map with automatic delay alerts.

solution.title: Incremental route optimization
solution.description: Route suggestions shipped region by region, measured weekly, and refined before expanding.

metrics.label: coordination time per delivery, down from hours

items.title: Financial Portfolio Management App
items.challenge: Users struggled to understand asset overviews due to an overly complex, slow-loading analytics UI.
items.summary: We redesigned the portfolio analytics interface so asset summaries read in seconds and pages load fast.
items.challengeDetail: The old dashboard showed dozens of charts at once and took several seconds to load. New users struggled to answer the most basic questions: what are my total assets and how are they doing.

solution.title: Research and simplification
solution.description: We interviewed users and kept only the metrics actually used to make decisions.

solution.title: A layered interface
solution.description: A summary on the main page, details on demand, with prototypes tested alongside users.

solution.title: Performance as a feature
solution.description: Data loads progressively and is computed on the server so pages feel instant.

items.title: Unified B2B Procurement Platform
items.challenge: Manual vendor compliance verification took up to two weeks per procurement cycle.
items.summary: We automated vendor document verification in a single procurement platform, turning a multi-week cycle into a matter of days.
items.challengeDetail: Vendor compliance documents arrived by email and were checked one by one by the team. A single procurement cycle could take two weeks, and vendor status lived in spreadsheets that were often out of sync.

solution.title: Verification rules
solution.description: We turned the compliance checklist into rules the system can execute.

solution.title: Automated verification flow
solution.description: Documents are uploaded, read, and matched automatically; only exceptions go to a person.

solution.title: Vendor status board
solution.description: The procurement team sees every vendor's position live, with a full audit trail.

items.question: What types of projects does NearTech take on?
items.answer: We handle digital products from initial strategy through long-term maintenance: web and mobile applications, internal tools, system integrations, and modernization of existing products.

items.question: Do we need complete specifications before reaching out?
items.answer: Not at all. Most projects begin with an ambiguous challenge. Our Strategy phase is explicitly designed to bring clarity.

items.question: How long does a project take and how much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope. Following an initial consultation, we provide a transparent written proposal detailing all assumptions so you can evaluate with full clarity.

items.question: Do you offer post-launch support and maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We offer continuous maintenance and iterative development on an ongoing, optional basis.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Send us a message using the form below. We'll reply promptly and schedule an initial consultation at no charge.
